_source: Kalmado Tour Services' own Calaguas advert, used with the operator's consent. Prices as published; no prices or coordinates were added that the advert does not give.

operator.business_description: Calaguas camping trips to iLOVECalaguas Resort on Mahabang Buhangin's white-sand beach, with pickup at Minaogan port, Vinzons. Published prices, no hidden charges. We also arrange exclusive trips, company tours, day tours and boat rental. Boats by Ayeisha Travel and Tour (boat owner, Kapitan Segundo); tour coordinator Kobe Mago (Bantayog Travel and Tour Services).
operator.payment_instructions: A ₱500 reservation fee per person secures your slot and is taken off the total. Message us for GCash details before you pay.

shared.cancellation_policy: A ₱500 reservation fee per person is taken off the total. It isn't refunded if you cancel, but you can pass your slot to someone else or use it on your next tour with us.
shared.good_to_know:
Electricity on the island comes from a generator from 6 PM to 6 AM only. Morning power can be arranged for a fee per hour.
The boat leaves once the coast guard signs the passenger list, so please don't be late. Times depend on the tide and weather.
Keep valuables safe, and watch out for stray cats and dogs and for sea urchins while island hopping. First aid is available.
The itinerary can change because of heavy traffic, bad weather or other things outside our control. Exclusive trips have a flexible itinerary.
things_to_bring: Plastic bags for your bag and phone
Pillow and blanket (comforters and pillows can be rented at the resort)

stops.description: Camp site at iLOVECalaguas Resort on the white-sand beach.

camping_inclusions: Island hopping and snorkelling at Balagbag Island (bring your own snorkel gear, or rent one)
1 tent for 2 people, with tent pitching
Port, environmental, resort entrance and tourism fees, and the coast guard pass
Camping, with free use of the toilets and showers
20 minutes in a crystal kayak for two
Free souvenir fridge magnet for every guest
camping_exclusions: Breakfast on day 1 at Vinzons before the boat (about ₱60 to ₱100)

camping_addons.name: Morning electricity (generator)
camping_addons.note: Arranged and paid on the island.

itinerary_day1: Arrive at Vinzons Tourism, Camarines Norte. Your tour coordinator meets you. Breakfast at your own cost, register and join the briefing.
Boat leaves for the Calaguas islands once the coast guard signs the passenger list. Late guests can't be waited for.
Arrive at Calaguas. The boatmen bring your things to the camp site and pitch your tent. Balong or Jaecer looks after you for the rest of your stay.
Rest, or walk past the rock formations to the other side of the beach and the I LOVE CALAGUAS sign.
Island hopping and snorkelling at Balagbag Island.
Back to the camp site, swim and rest.
itinerary_day2_morning: Breakfast (meal 3), then rest, swim and rinse off. Good times for the free kayak: 7 to 8 AM or 2 to 3 PM.

packages.title: Calaguas camping, 2 days 1 night
packages.description: Two days on Mahabang Buhangin, Calaguas' long white-sand beach, camping at iLOVECalaguas Resort. All in from Minaogan port, Vinzons: 4 hosted meals (lunch, dinner, snacks and breakfast), island hopping at Balagbag, a sunrise trek up Tinaga Hill, boat transfers, insurance, fees and your tent. You can also join with a van from Manila. Published price, no hidden charges.
packages.meals_note: 4 hosted meals: lunch, dinner, snacks and breakfast

variants.variant_name: With van from Manila and back

itinerary_day2_end: Pack up and hand back the tent, then the boat back to Minaogan port, Vinzons.
